frontier.hypothesis: If the function is ever reopened, the only remaining un-falsified direction is a chassis in which the SECOND loop's pointer is not a copy or a re-derivation of the first at all - e.g. both matrices addressed through one real PsyQ `MATRIX *` local with &m[0] / &m[1], so that loop2's &m[1] is an ordinary re-scoped address expression rather than out3 = out2 or out3 = pa4 + 0x20.
frontier.mechanism: a4 addresses two adjacent 0x20-byte objects and PsyQ's MATRIX is 0x20 bytes; func_8004A348(buf, m) builds a rotation matrix and func_800523E0(m0, m1, a3, dst) consumes the pair. A MATRIX-typed local changes the RTL address expressions cc1 emits for both pointers (scaled index vs plain plus), which is the one input to the allocno-priority arithmetic that every chassis measured so far holds fixed.
frontier.next_probe: Re-spell candidate.c with `MATRIX *m = (MATRIX *)a4;` and &m[0] / &m[1] everywhere (including loop2's re-take), then read the .lreg priority table and seat verdict via tmp/grind/func_80041188/s10/batch.sh under WSL. This was carried unspent from s8/s9 as Judge-facing cosmetics; s11's arithmetic makes it the only structural variable left, since it is the only change that can move out2's live-range endpoints rather than just its reference count.

frontier.hypothesis: candidate.c can be made genuinely FAKE-free by finding a replacement for the load-bearing `stptr = base; stptr += 0xFC;` chain-extender that reaches stptr 7 refs / live 41 without a byte-neutral detour.
frontier.mechanism: stptr must outrank stptr2 (6 refs / 48 = 2500) to keep $s3; at live 41 that needs >= 7 references, and target emits only a single addiu for its definition, so the extra references have to come from real in-loop uses of stptr rather than from its initialisation.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate loop1 spellings in which stptr is read for real values that target already computes from it (stptr + 0x38, stptr + 6, stptr + 0x68) as separate named intermediates or repeated reads instead of folded expressions; measure r88's refs/live in .lreg and require build_insns == 132.
